decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvers, ducts or other external plant shall be installed.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 0900 to 2330 Monday to Saturday and 0900 to 2230 Sundays.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0900 to 1800 on Mondays to Fridays, 0900 to 1300 Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The front door (on to Devonshire Road) shall not be opened except for escape in the event of an emergency.
Condition : 8 - The area between the front wall of the premises and the edge of Devonshire Road shall not be used for outdoor seating or dining.

Condition : 9 - Before the use hereby permitted is brought into operation, the soundproofing measures described in the report by Sandy Brown associates LLP reference 11256/DR and received 08/11/2011 and drawing 2060 received 08/11/2011 shall be fully implemented. These measures shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 10 - The rear door on the premises shall be fitted with an alarm and a self closer and shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order. The rear door shall be permanently closed except for when it required to be opened in an emergency.
Condition : 11 - No music shall be played within the premises.
Condition : 12 - No openings shall be formed within the external surfaces of the approved rear extension.
Condition : 13 - The ground floor of the premises shall only be used a dining area ancillary to the use of No's 5-7 Devonshire Road and no part of it shall be used as a kitchen.
Condition : 14 - The ground floor of the premises shall only be used a dining area ancillary to the use of No's 5-7 Devonshire Road and shall not be used as a separate, independent operation.

Condition : 15 - No development shall be commenced until a scheme for the soundproofing of the hereby approved rear extension has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 16 - All glazing used in the proposed shop front shall be double glazing.
Condition : 17 - There shall be nothing fixed to the north facing wall of No 3 Devonshire Road.
description: Change of use from A1 (retail) to A3 (restaurant), erection of single storey rear extension and internal alterations and replacement shopfront to provide ancillary use for the existing restaurant at No's 5-7 Devonshire Road
